project_metadata.project_name: Hydropower Generation and Reservoir Release Optimization Subsystem (Component 3)
project_metadata.target_facility: Kukule Ganga Power Station, Sabaragamuwa Province, Sri Lanka
project_metadata.basin: Kukule Ganga (Upper Tributary of Kalu Ganga Basin)
project_metadata.dataset_purpose: Scientifically defensible synthetic dataset for Linear Programming (LP) and Deep Q-Network (DQN) optimization models

installed_capacity_mw.source_description: Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) official power station asset register and nameplate rating
installed_capacity_mw.engineering_notes: Total nominal continuous electrical generating capacity across two identical 35 MW units.

num_units.source_description: CEB generation system master plans and powerhouse architectural drawings
num_units.engineering_notes: Underground powerhouse houses two identical vertical Francis turbine-generator units.

nominal_unit_capacity_mw.source_description: CEB official station rating (70 MW total / 2 units)
nominal_unit_capacity_mw.engineering_notes: Continuous nominal generator output rating per unit at nominal power factor (0.85 lag).

turbine_type.source_description: Manufacturer specification and CEB plant profile
turbine_type.engineering_notes: Medium-to-high head reaction Francis turbines coupled to vertical synchronous generators.

turbine_maximum_output_per_unit_mw.source_description: Newly supplied engineering details (turbine maximum mechanical capability)
turbine_maximum_output_per_unit_mw.engineering_notes: Turbine runner maximum mechanical shaft power. Cannot be assumed as unrestricted continuous station operating point without generator stator thermal rating, step-up transformer capacity (MVA), and CEB transmission dispatch authorization.

turbine_rated_discharge_per_unit_m3s.source_description: Newly supplied engineering details at rated output of 37.5 MW per runner
turbine_rated_discharge_per_unit_m3s.engineering_notes: Rated discharge at design net head (176.1 m) producing 37.5 MW shaft power. Replaces previous assumption of 23.75 m3/s per unit pending confirmation.

turbine_rated_output_at_design_q_mw.engineering_notes: Turbine mechanical rating at 24 m3/s design discharge. Exceeds 35.0 MW nominal generator rating by 2.5 MW (overload/head margin).

maximum_gross_head_m.engineering_notes: Occurs at Pond Full Supply Level (206.00 MASL). Implies an effective operational tailwater elevation of 19.60 MASL (206.00 - 186.40 = 19.60 MASL), distinct from the outfall invert.

maximum_net_head_m.engineering_notes: Design net head at Full Supply Level (206.00 MASL) under full rated discharge. Implies total system hydraulic head loss of 10.30 m (186.40 - 176.10 = 10.30 m).

minimum_net_head_m.engineering_notes: Net head available at Minimum Operating Level (204.00 MASL). Exactly 2.00 m below maximum net head, matching the 2.00 m active pondage drawdown range.

pond_full_spill_level_masl.source_description: CEB weir operational guidelines, weir crest / radial gate spillway crest
pond_full_spill_level_masl.engineering_notes: Full Supply Level (FSL). Inflow exceeding turbine throughput is spilled above this elevation.

minimum_operating_level_masl.engineering_notes: Minimum Operating Level (MOL) of pondage. Lowered from baseline assumption of 204.25 MASL, expanding active pond stage range to 2.00 m.

usable_storage_m3.source_description: CEB official station description (1.67 million m3)
usable_storage_m3.engineering_notes: Usable active pondage storage volume between MOL and FSL for daily peaking regulation.

headrace_length_m.engineering_notes: Total length of low-pressure concrete-lined headrace tunnel from intake weir to surge tank. Refined from previous rounded 5,790 m.

headrace_diameter_m.engineering_notes: Finished internal diameter of circular headrace tunnel (cross-sectional area A = 24.63 m2; velocity V = 1.95 m/s at 48 m3/s).

tailrace_length_m.engineering_notes: Length of discharge tailrace tunnel from powerhouse draft tube manifold to river outfall portal.

tailrace_slope_pct.engineering_notes: Longitudinal tunnel floor grade (0.0058 m/m), producing an elevation change of 9.28 m over 1,600 m length.

tailrace_outfall_invert_masl.engineering_notes: Physical invert (floor) level of tailrace tunnel outfall structure into the river. Must not be confused with operating tailwater level under discharge.

generator_frequency_hz.source_description: Sri Lanka National Grid Standard / CEB Transmission Code
generator_frequency_hz.engineering_notes: Synchronous electrical frequency of Sri Lanka power grid.

generator_rated_voltage_kv.engineering_notes: Generator terminal line-to-line RMS voltage before main step-up transformer (13.8 kV to 132 kV).

commissioning_year.engineering_notes: Commercial operational commissioning date of Kukule Ganga Power Station.

station_specifications.facility_type: Run-of-river with pondage (regulator weir, headrace tunnel, and underground powerhouse)

meteorological_parameters.reference_station: Ratnapura Meteorological Station (DoM Sri Lanka / CHIRPS Admin-2 LK91)

hydrological_parameters.model_type: Two-Store Conceptual Catchment Water Balance (GR4J/Thornthwaite Adaptation with Unit Hydrograph Routing)

planned_maintenance_schedule.reason: Annual Unit 1 overhaul during dry window

operating_constraints_notes.continuous_capacity_policy: Station capacity remains strictly capped at 70.0 MW (1,680.0 MWh/day) until generator stator, transformer, and transmission export ratings are authoritatively reconciled against 40 MW turbine runner peak capability.
operating_constraints_notes.discharge_limit_policy: Station rated discharge is represented as 24.0 m3/s per unit (provisional 48.0 m3/s total), with baseline 47.5 m3/s retained as a selectable alternative.
operating_constraints_notes.hydraulic_headloss_policy: Total waterway system head loss is calibrated to 10.30 m at full rated discharge based on benchmark gross-to-net head differential (186.4 m gross down to 176.1 m net at FSL).

dashboard_2026_10_18_validation.discrepancy_explanation: The 1835.300 MWh reading reported for Kukule PS on 2026-10-18 physically exceeds the absolute maximum 24-hour generation possible for a 70 MW station (70 MW * 24 h = 1680.0 MWh). The source inspection shows this test page (/test/test/index.php) lacked live production telemetry validation and likely reported cumulative/uncalibrated values. In accordance with physical engineering constraints, 1680.0 MWh is strictly enforced as the maximum daily ceiling, and the discrepancy is logged for scientific provenance.
